content.cn:
v26.2.3 已发布！这次把数据路径、窗口细条恢复和触屏回弹几处涟漪都抚平了。

本次更新重点包括：

- 移除便携模式开关，数据固定安装目录并自动迁移 AppData
- 修复启动窗口变细条：非法尺寸拒绝写入，呼出时按习惯尺寸自愈（默认 1280×720）
- 数据向下兼容：能读的正常读，读不懂的先留着，回退旧版也能用
- 禁用触屏滑到底回弹；点名滚动减少 DOM 重渲染

详细内容可在「设置 → 更新日志」查看。欢迎通过 GitHub Issues 反馈问题与建议。
content.en:
v26.2.3 has been released! This update smooths out data-path, thin-strip window restore, and touch overscroll issues.

Highlights include:

- Portable mode removed; data always lives under the install directory with automatic AppData migration
- Fixed thin-strip windows: illegal sizes are rejected and restored from habitual size (default 1280×720)
- Downward-compatible data: readable fields load, unknown fields are kept for after upgrade
- Disabled touch overscroll bounce; roller hot path reduces DOM re-renders

See Settings → Changelog for details. Use GitHub Issues for feedback.

content.cn:
v26.2.2 已发布！本版本专注于在**不减少任何视觉效果**的前提下降低 CPU 与内存占用，让程序在老旧的平台上更加流畅，也不会因本程序拖慢其他应用。

本次更新重点包括：

- 横幅倒计时改为合成器驱动动画，与旧版视觉逐帧一致，但主线程不再每 100ms 更新
- 构建分包优化冷启动（入口包 814KB → 445KB）
- 保留全部动画效果，性能模式下行为与旧版完全一致
- Windows 安装器自动适配系统语言（中文/英文）、显示 GPL-3.0 许可证、图标与程序一致

详细内容可在「设置 → 更新日志」查看。欢迎通过 GitHub Issues 反馈问题与建议。
content.en:
v26.2.2 has been released! This version focuses on reducing CPU and memory usage **without removing any visual effects**, so the program runs smoother on older hardware and does not slow down other applications.

Highlights include:

- Banner countdowns are now compositor-driven, frame-identical to the old version, but no per-100ms main-thread updates
- Build splitting improves cold start (entry chunk 814KB → 445KB)
- All visual effects preserved; performance-mode behavior is identical to the previous version
- The Windows installer now auto-adapts to the system language (Chinese/English), shows the GPL-3.0 license, and uses the app icon

See Settings → Changelog for details. Use GitHub Issues for feedback.

content.cn:
v26.2.1 已发布！本版本修复了 v26.2.0 的构建失败问题，并恢复 Release、GitHub Pages 与插件 SDK 的发布流程。

本次更新重点包括：

- 移除设置页中重复声明的悬浮窗样式同步函数，修复构建失败
- 发布流程全面统一使用 bun，安装、测试与构建更加稳定

详细内容可在「设置 → 更新日志」查看。欢迎通过 GitHub Issues 反馈问题与建议。
content.en:
v26.2.1 has been released! This version fixes the v26.2.0 build failure and restores the Release, GitHub Pages, and Plugin SDK publishing pipelines.

Highlights include:

- Removed duplicate floating-window style sync declarations in Settings that broke the build
- All publishing pipelines now consistently use bun for more stable installs, tests, and builds

See Settings → Changelog for details. Use GitHub Issues for feedback.

content.cn:
v26.1.0 的功能开发已完成，主程序正式 Release 已提供正式下载。

本次更新重点包括：

- 完整插件系统：在线安装、更新、卸载、依赖、纯净恢复模式与本地 `.cnrp` 调试
- 宿主原生 Fluent 插件页面、跨平台能力桥接，以及名单、记录、统计和平衡数据只读保护
- 官方插件模板、Fluent 组件/API Pages 与『来点音效』v1.1.0 示例插件
- Tauri `cyrenenr` URI、Web Hash 一次性参数及指定 Roller 配置后自动开始滚动
- 跨管理员权限单实例 IPC、双模式开机启动、启动到托盘与启动动画时序修复
- 人员性别与 Roller 性别筛选、公平算法状态标识、新成员统计初始化策略
- CSV/JSON/XLSX/CYRENE 智能拖入导入及名单身份信息保护
- 正式移除 Electron 支持，后续核心版本仅维护 Web 与 Tauri

详细内容可在「设置 → 更新日志」查看。测试期间如发现异常，请暂时保留 26.0.5 安装包并通过 GitHub Issues 反馈。
content.en:
Development for v26.1.0 is substantially complete and the Tauri installer is now in pre-release testing. **The main application Release has not been published yet.** A public download will follow after testing succeeds.

Highlights include the complete plugin system and native Fluent plugin pages; cross-platform bridges with read-only protection for lists, records, statistics, and balance data; the official plugin template and Sound Effects v1.1.0; desktop URI and Web hash one-time Roller parameters; cross-elevation single-instance IPC; two startup methods and startup-to-tray fixes; gender-aware draws and fairness status; new-member statistics policies; smart CSV/JSON/XLSX/CYRENE drag-and-drop import; and the removal of Electron support.

See Settings → Changelog for details. Keep the v26.0.5 installer during testing and report issues through GitHub Issues.
